resources.string: "Open Android settings → Performance Management (formerly DuraSpeed). Enable MiniScreen Takeover in its app list. Otherwise the system may terminate the app after a few minutes in the background. You must make this change manually."
"This is your confirmation. The app cannot automatically verify these manufacturer settings."
"I have enabled MiniScreen Takeover in Performance Management."
"Open the manufacturer’s Miniscreen / Subscreen Settings and apply the following settings. The English names below help you find the options."
"Turn off every other switch, including call and notification options."
"Exception: the music player switch may stay on."
"Scroll to the bottom and check every section. Backlight level can be adjusted separately."
"Open the relevant page manually in Android settings."
"I have adjusted all Miniscreen settings as described."
"Notification access is required only to show notifications on the rear display. Granting access does not enable the ticker or select apps. You can also set it up later."

"Open the app details for MiniScreen Takeover. In the three-dot menu at the top, select “Allow restricted settings”. Confirm with your PIN or fingerprint if requested. Then return here and optionally grant notification access below. This step allows restricted settings; notification access is granted separately. If the menu item is absent, try granting notification access first and check the app details again."
